_readme: S644, 2026-11-13. Reads 1-5 found that Diablo Valley's eLumen catalog prints every award's requirements (content call catalog,program,<slug>, run 43342877522) but lists none of them: its full publish call names no program,<slug> (run 43343491672), so the program index is www.dvc.edu's grid of program areas, whose area pages link each award into eLumen. The grid pages by ?page=0..5 with 13 areas on its first page. This read loads the last grid page once, to count the areas a reader would load (5 x 13 plus this page's). No model call.

questions.area_count: How many program areas does the grid's last page (?page=5) list, and does it name a page past it?
